about: This template stacks two shots from Spider-Man 3. On top, Tobey Maguire's Peter Parker smiles happily in a dark theater audience, completely unaware. Below, James Franco's Harry Osborn sits a few rows away and stares at him with half-closed eyes and a smug, knowing look. The meme labels the oblivious person on top and the silent watcher underneath, turning the image into a picture of someone being judged, plotted against or quietly found out without realising it.
origin: Both shots come from the 2007 Sony film Spider-Man 3, during the scene where Peter and Harry watch Mary Jane perform on stage while their friendship has turned hostile.
usage:
The top box describes the person or thing in the top panel, usually "me" doing something they think is going unnoticed. The bottom box labels Harry: whoever is watching and knows the truth.

The joke works when the top line sounds innocent and the bottom line reveals why it isn't: pretending to work while the boss watches, claiming to have read the book in front of the author, a cheat code next to the anti-cheat. Keep the bottom label short; Franco's face already says everything.
ideas: me saying i've seen the movie
my friend who knows i haven't
me using a free trial with a fake email
me copying a stack overflow answer
me playing on the ranked servers
aka: James Franco Staring at Tobey Maguire
